assumptions: Each schema-2 snapshot stores exactly one satellite record.
Added means only in second; removed means only in first, regardless of retrieval chronology.
Element differences may reflect epoch, fitting or source updates; they are not physical change measurements.
State differences use second minus first at one common time; no covariance or uncertainty is quantified.
SGP4 WGS72, geocentric TEME; optional Astropy ITRS retains strict local EOP/leap policies.
A same-snapshot comparison is a self-check, not distinct historical evidence.
body.caution: Differences between two orbital-data snapshots do not, by themselves, prove that a satellite performed a maneuver or experienced an anomaly. Further evidence and appropriate scientific analysis are required.
